an3.33:1.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca :
an3.33:1.2: saṅkhittenapi kho ahaṃ sāriputta dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
an3.33:1.3: vitthārenapi kho ahaṃ sāriputta dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
an3.33:1.4: saṅkhittavitthārenapi kho ahaṃ sāriputta dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
an3.33:1.6: etassa bhagavā kālo, etassa sugata kālo,
an3.33:1.7: yaṃ bhagavā saṅkhittenapi dhammaṃ deseyya, vitthārenapi dhammaṃ deseyya, saṅkhittavitthārenapi dhammaṃ deseyya.
an3.33:2.2: imasmiṃ ca saviññāṇake kāye ahiṅkāramamiṅkāramānānusayā na bhavissanti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahiṅkāramamiṅkāramānānusayā na bhavissanti, yaṃ ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ upasampajja viharato ahiṅkāramamiṅkāramānānusayā na honti, taṃ ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ upasampajja viharissāmāti.
an3.33:3.1: yato ca kho sāriputta bhikkhuno imasmiṃ ca saviññāṇake kāye ahiṅkāramamiṅkāramānānusayā na honti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahiṅkāramamiṅkāramānānusayā na honti, yaṃ ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ upasampajja viharato ahiṅkāramamiṅkāramānānusayā na honti, taṃ ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an3.33:3.3: bhikkhu acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vāvattayī saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassa.
an3.33:3.4: idaṃ ca pana metaṃ sāriputta sandhāya bhāsitaṃ pārāyaṇe udayapañhe.
